html:
The Winda Winda were a small Aboriginal Australian group of the west coast of Cape York Peninsula, on the map south of today's Weipa, toward the Archer River.

Almost nothing is recorded about them. Their neighbours on the map are the Mbeiwum, the Awngthim and the Wik peoples of the Aurukun coast. Like other groups of this coast, they lived from the sea, the estuaries and the woodland behind them.
